    exception = exception or bool(re.search(r"\b(?:actual duties|misleading|bookkeep\w*|clerical)\b", business_text))
    negated_duties = bool(re.search(r"\b(?:no|not|never|without|unconfirmed|unknown)\b[^.!?\n]{0,60}\b(?:kitchen|dining room|restaurant shifts|prepare|serve|meal preparation|duties)\b", context_text))
    negated_industry = bool(re.search(r"\b(?:no|not|never)\b[^.!?\n]{0,30}\brestaurant\b", business_text))
    context_conflict = exception or negated_duties or negated_industry or bool(unmapped) or bool(extra_columns)
    if context_conflict:
        issues.append(OpenItem("Duty evidence requires review", "The supplied prose contains negated observations, employee duty exceptions or other occupations outside this adapter's supported restaurant context.", "Review actual duties and resolve exceptions before assigning a code; titles do not override those statements.", context_refs))
    timesheets_present = any("timesheet" in Path(name).stem.lower() for name in documents)
    no_timesheets = bool(re.search(r"\bno (?:employee )?timesheets (?:are available|exist|were kept)\b", context_text))
    positive_timesheets = bool(re.search(r"(?:^|[.!?]\s+)\s*(?:employee )?timesheets (?:are|were) (?:available|kept|provided)\b|\b(?:we|employer) (?:has|have|keeps|kept) (?:employee )?timesheets\b", context_text, re.M))
    sheets = True if timesheets_present or positive_timesheets else False if no_timesheets else None
    has_catering = any(_CATERING_POSITION.match(str(row.values.get("position", ""))) for row in payroll.rows)
    if has_catering and sheets is not False:
        issues.append(OpenItem("Employee timesheets", "No record confirms that employee timesheets are unavailable, or timesheet records are present; the verified mixed-duty rule requires no employee timesheets.", "Confirm timesheet availability and provide records or an authoritative no-timesheets statement.", context_refs))
    if has_catering and (timesheets_present or positive_timesheets) and no_timesheets:
        issues.append(OpenItem("Conflicting timesheet evidence", "Field notes deny available timesheets but a source or another statement indicates timesheets exist.", "Resolve the conflicting evidence before applying the no-timesheets rule.", context_refs))
    decisions = {}
    for employee, row in zip(register, payroll.rows):
        evidence = (employee.source, *context_refs)
        position = str(row.values.get("position", ""))
        if period is None or not restaurant or business is None or notes is None or context_conflict:
            decision = _pending("Confirm this employee's actual duties, restaurant industry and exact audit period; this adapter has no rule for other contexts.", evidence)
        elif _CATERING_POSITION.match(position):
            facts = RuleFacts(employee.employee_id, "restaurant", "catering_crew", period.start, period.end,
                              complete=bool(receipts and receipts.coverage_confirmed),
                              evidence_sources=(*evidence, *(receipts.sources if receipts else ())),
                              mixed_catering_restaurant_duties=mixed_observed,
                              employee_timesheets_available=sheets,
                              total_gross_receipts=receipts.total if receipts else None,
                              offsite_catering_receipts=receipts.offsite if receipts else None)
            guide_refs, verified_guide = _guide_refs(evaluator, ("CG-02", "CG-07", "CG-41", "CG-42"))
            decision = evaluator.evaluate("catering_receipts", facts) if verified_guide else _pending("The current guide's catering definitions differ from verified CG-02/CG-07/CG-41/CG-42; obtain auditor review.", facts.evidence_sources, guide_refs)
        elif _RESTAURANT_POSITION.fullmatch(position) and dining_observed:
            decision = _direct_restaurant(evaluator, evidence)
        else:
            decision = _pending("Register title and supplied observations do not establish supported actual duties; obtain employee duty evidence or an applicable rule.", evidence)
        decisions[employee.employee_id] = decision
        if decision.status == "OPEN":
            issues.append(OpenItem(f"{employee.name} [{employee.employee_id}]", decision.reason, "; ".join(decision.required_confirmation), decision.evidence_sources + decision.rule_sources))
    return _finish(inputs, payroll, period, receipts, register, decisions, issues, application, interview, interview_errors)


def _finish(inputs, payroll, period, receipts, register, decisions, issues, application, interview, interview_errors, *, proposals=None, site_visits=None, adjustments=None, adapted_adjustment_sources=(), parts=None, evidence_open=False):
    """Share the existing exact-cent allocation, comparison and reconciliation."""
    allocation = allocate_payroll(register, decisions) if parts is None else allocate_parts(register, parts, decisions)
    # Rebuild the register from the loaded raw rows, independently of emitted lines.
    independent = reconcile_payroll(records_from_csv(payroll), allocation.lines)
    if not independent.reconciled:
        raise AllocationError("Independent payroll reconciliation failed")
    adjuster = PayrollAdjuster(inputs.guide, interview, source_errors=interview_errors)
    # No monetary adjustment schema is adapted in this first restaurant path.
    # Use the existing component for the empty evidenced set and expose any
    # candidate documents as OPEN, without accepting unbound external claims.
    adjustments = adjustments if adjustments is not None else adjuster.evaluate_batch()
    for line in adjustments.lines:
        if line.status == "OPEN":
            issues.append(OpenItem(line.adjustment_id, line.reason, "; ".join(line.required_confirmation), line.evidence_sources + line.rule_sources))
    unadapted_adjustments = False
    for document in inputs.records:
        if _adjustment_evidence(document) and str(document.path) not in adapted_adjustment_sources:
            unadapted_adjustments = True
            issues.append(OpenItem("Unadapted adjustment evidence", f"{document.path} may contain adjustment evidence that has not been supplied as verified typed cases.", "Provide sourced subcontractor/travel cases before treating adjustment processing as complete.", (_source(document, "adjustment evidence"),)))
    cents = {code: _cents(amount, code) for code, amount in allocation.by_code.items()}
    for code, amount in adjustments.by_code.items():
        cents[code] = cents.get(code, 0) + _cents(amount, code)
    by_code = {code: _money(amount) for code, amount in sorted(cents.items())}
    comparison = _application(application, register, allocation, by_code, evidence_open or unadapted_adjustments or any(line.status == "OPEN" for line in adjustments.lines), issues)
    return ProcessingResult(inputs, period, receipts, register, decisions, allocation, adjustments, by_code, comparison, independent, tuple(issues), proposals or {}, site_visits or {})

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
import csv
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
from typing import Iterable


# These are column names, not employer names or classification rules.
DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS = frozenset({
    "wages_paid", "gross_pay", "travel_allowance_paid", "amount_paid",
    "dine_in_receipts", "offsite_catering_receipts",
})
_MONEY = re.compile(r"[+-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?")
_PARAGRAPH = re.compile(r"(?m)^[ \t]*(?:#{1,6}[ \t]+)?(?:\*\*)?(CG-[0-9]+)\.")


class InputError(ValueError):
    """A source cannot be read or does not meet the documented input format."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class MarkdownSource:
    path: Path
    text: str
    paragraph_ids: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CSVRow:
    line_number: int
    values: dict[str, str | Decimal]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CSVSource:
    path: Path
    text: str
    columns: tuple[str, ...]
    rows: tuple[CSVRow, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Inputs:
    guide: MarkdownSource
    records_root: Path
    records: tuple[MarkdownSource | CSVSource, ...]


def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        # Preserve line endings and any BOM in source text for later citation.
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
            return source.read()
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: expected UTF-8 text: {exc}") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: cannot read source: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc


def read_markdown(path: str | Path) -> MarkdownSource:
    """Preserve Markdown text and paragraph-definition identifiers in source order."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    identifiers = tuple(_PARAGRAPH.findall(text.removeprefix("\ufeff")))
    return MarkdownSource(path, text, identifiers)


def _csv_lines(text: str, path: Path) -> Iterable[str]:
    """Check quote placement that csv.reader(strict=True) otherwise accepts."""
    state = "start"
    for line_number, line in enumerate(io.StringIO(text.removeprefix("\ufeff"), newline=""), 1):
        for character in line:
            if state == "quoted":
                if character == '"':
                    state = "closed"
            elif state == "closed":
                if character == '"':  # Doubled quote within a quoted field.
                    state = "quoted"
                elif character in ",\r\n":
                    state = "start"
                else:
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: character after closing quote")
            elif character == '"':
                if state != "start":
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: quote inside unquoted field")
                state = "quoted"
            elif character in ",\r\n":
                state = "start"
            else:
                state = "bare"
        yield line


def read_csv(
    path: str | Path, *, money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> CSVSource:
    """Read a strict CSV table, converting configured money columns to Decimal."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    money_columns = frozenset(money_columns)
    parser = csv.reader(_csv_lines(text, path), strict=True)
    rows = []
    try:
        header = next(parser, None)
        if not header:
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV header is missing")
        if any(not name or name != name.strip() for name in header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV headers must be nonblank without surrounding whitespace")
        if len(set(header)) != len(header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: duplicate CSV header")
        while True:
            line_number = parser.line_num + 1
            row = next(parser, None)
            if row is None:
                break
            if not row:  # Blank physical lines do not create evidence rows.
                continue
            if len(row) != len(header):
                raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: expected {len(header)} fields, got {len(row)}")
            values: dict[str, str | Decimal] = dict(zip(header, row))
            for column, value in zip(header, row):
                if column in money_columns:
                    if not _MONEY.fullmatch(value.strip()):
                        raise InputError(
                            f"{path}:{line_number}: invalid money in column {column!r}: {value!r}; "
                            "expected plain decimal dollars with at most two fractional digits"
                        )
                    values[column] = Decimal(value.strip())
            rows.append(CSVRow(line_number, values))
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}:{parser.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}") from exc
    return CSVSource(path, text, tuple(header), tuple(rows))


def read_inputs(
    guide_path: str | Path,
    employer_records_path: str | Path,
    *,
    money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> Inputs:
    """Reread a guide and all Markdown/CSV records below a caller-supplied directory.

    The directory can hold one employer or any number of employer subdirectories.
    No employer names, minimum employer count, or classification answers are assumed.
    """
    guide = read_markdown(guide_path)
    if not guide.paragraph_ids:
        raise InputError(f"{guide.path}: no classification paragraph identifiers (CG-...) found")
    root = Path(employer_records_path)
    try:
        is_directory = root.is_dir()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: cannot access employer records directory: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc
    if not is_directory:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: employer records directory is missing or is not a directory")

    def walk_error(exc: OSError) -> None:
        raise InputError(f"{exc.filename}: cannot list employer records: {exc.strerror}") from exc

    paths = sorted(
        Path(directory) / name
        for directory, _, names in os.walk(root, onerror=walk_error)
        for name in names
        if Path(name).suffix.lower() in {".md", ".csv"}
    )
    if not paths:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: no Markdown or CSV employer records found")
    money_columns = frozenset(money_columns)
    records = tuple(
        read_csv(path, money_columns=money_columns)
        if path.suffix.lower() == ".csv" else read_markdown(path)
        for path in paths
    )
    return Inputs(guide, root, records)


def inventory(inputs: Inputs) -> dict:
    """Summarize the input inventory without calculating payroll totals or allocations."""
    tables = [doc for doc in inputs.records if isinstance(doc, CSVSource)]
    return {
        "guide": {"path": str(inputs.guide.path), "paragraph_ids": inputs.guide.paragraph_ids},
        "records_root": str(inputs.records_root),
        "record_files": len(inputs.records),
        "markdown_files": len(inputs.records) - len(tables),
        "csv_files": len(tables),
        "csv_rows": sum(len(table.rows) for table in tables),
        "decimal_values": sum(
            isinstance(value, Decimal)
            for table in tables for row in table.rows for value in row.values.values()
        ),
        "records_by_directory": dict(sorted(Counter(
            doc.path.parent.relative_to(inputs.records_root).as_posix()
            for doc in inputs.records
        ).items())),
        "sources": [doc.path.relative_to(inputs.records_root).as_posix() for doc in inputs.records],
    }

def _cents(value: Decimal, context: str) -> int:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: wages must be a finite Decimal, got {value!r}")
    numerator, denominator = value.as_integer_ratio()
    cents, remainder = divmod(numerator * 100, denominator)
    if remainder:
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: sub-cent wages {value!r}; no rounding policy is assumed")
    return cents


def _money(cents: int) -> Decimal:
    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
    return Decimal(f"{'-' if cents < 0 else ''}{whole}.{fraction:02d}")


def _identifier(value: str, context: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value != value.strip():
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: identifier must be a nonblank string without surrounding whitespace")
    return value


def _source_key(source: SourceReference) -> tuple:
    if not isinstance(source, SourceReference) or not isinstance(source.source, str) or not source.source.strip() or not isinstance(source.locator, str) or not source.locator.strip():
        raise AllocationError("Payroll evidence requires a source filename and record locator")
    return source.source, ("line", source.line_start) if source.line_start else ("locator", source.locator)

        if employee in employees:
            raise AllocationError(f"{employee}: duplicate employee in payroll register")

def _cents(value: Decimal, context: str) -> int:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: wages must be a finite Decimal, got {value!r}")
    numerator, denominator = value.as_integer_ratio()
    cents, remainder = divmod(numerator * 100, denominator)
    if remainder:
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: sub-cent wages {value!r}; no rounding policy is assumed")
    return cents


def _money(cents: int) -> Decimal:
    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
    return Decimal(f"{'-' if cents < 0 else ''}{whole}.{fraction:02d}")

    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value != value.strip():

    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():

def _finish(inputs, payroll, period, receipts, register, decisions, issues, application, interview, interview_errors, *, proposals=None, site_visits=None, adjustments=None, adapted_adjustment_sources=(), parts=None, evidence_open=False):

    # Rebuild the register from the loaded raw rows, independently of emitted lines.
    independent = reconcile_payroll(records_from_csv(payroll), allocation.lines)
    if not independent.reconciled:
        raise AllocationError("Independent payroll reconciliation failed")
    adjuster = PayrollAdjuster(inputs.guide, interview, source_errors=interview_errors)
    # No monetary adjustment schema is adapted in this first restaurant path.
    # Use the existing component for the empty evidenced set and expose any
    # candidate documents as OPEN, without accepting unbound external claims.
    adjustments = adjustments if adjustments is not None else adjuster.evaluate_batch()
    for line in adjustments.lines:
        if line.status == "OPEN":
            issues.append(OpenItem(line.adjustment_id, line.reason, "; ".join(line.required_confirmation), line.evidence_sources + line.rule_sources))
    unadapted_adjustments = False
    for document in inputs.records:
        if _adjustment_evidence(document) and str(document.path) not in adapted_adjustment_sources:
            unadapted_adjustments = True
            issues.append(OpenItem("Unadapted adjustment evidence", f"{document.path} may contain adjustment evidence that has not been supplied as verified typed cases.", "Provide sourced subcontractor/travel cases before treating adjustment processing as complete.", (_source(document, "adjustment evidence"),)))
    cents = {code: _cents(amount, code) for code, amount in allocation.by_code.items()}
    for code, amount in adjustments.by_code.items():
        cents[code] = cents.get(code, 0) + _cents(amount, code)
    by_code = {code: _money(amount) for code, amount in sorted(cents.items())}
    comparison = _application(application, register, allocation, by_code, evidence_open or unadapted_adjustments or any(line.status == "OPEN" for line in adjustments.lines), issues)
    return ProcessingResult(inputs, period, receipts, register, decisions, allocation, adjustments, by_code, comparison, independent, tuple(issues), proposals or {}, site_visits or {})

def _cents(value: Decimal, context: str) -> int:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal) or not value.is_finite():
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: wages must be a finite Decimal, got {value!r}")
    numerator, denominator = value.as_integer_ratio()
    cents, remainder = divmod(numerator * 100, denominator)
    if remainder:
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: sub-cent wages {value!r}; no rounding policy is assumed")
    return cents


def _money(cents: int) -> Decimal:
    whole, fraction = divmod(abs(cents), 100)
    return Decimal(f"{'-' if cents < 0 else ''}{whole}.{fraction:02d}")


def _identifier(value: str, context: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value != value.strip():
        raise AllocationError(f"{context}: identifier must be a nonblank string without surrounding whitespace")
    return value


def _source_key(source: SourceReference) -> tuple:
    if not isinstance(source, SourceReference) or not isinstance(source.source, str) or not source.source.strip() or not isinstance(source.locator, str) or not source.locator.strip():
        raise AllocationError("Payroll evidence requires a source filename and record locator")
    return source.source, ("line", source.line_start) if source.line_start else ("locator", source.locator)


def _register(records: Iterable[PayrollRecord]) -> dict[str, PayrollRecord]:
    employees = {}
    sources = set()
    for record in records:
        employee = _identifier(record.employee_id, "Register employee")
        if employee in employees:
            raise AllocationError(f"{employee}: duplicate employee in payroll register")

        document.text.count("\n", 0, start + len(excerpt)) + 1,

def _guide_refs(evaluator, identifiers):
    refs = tuple(ref for ref in evaluator.rule_sources["courier_week"] if ref.locator in identifiers)

def _day(value):
    try:
        result = date.fromisoformat(value)
        return result if result.isoformat() == value else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _week(day):
    return day - timedelta(days=day.weekday())


def _weeks(period):
    if period is None or period.start.weekday() != 0 or period.end.weekday() != 6:
        return ()
    return tuple(period.start + timedelta(days=offset) for offset in range(0, (period.end - period.start).days + 1, 7))


def _number(value):
    return int(value) if value.isdigit() else _NUMBERS.get(value)

def _application(document, register, allocation, by_code, adjustment_open, issues):
    if document is None:
        return None
    reported = []
    offset = 0

    in_table = False
    for line in document.text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        is_table = line.lstrip().startswith("|")
        if is_table and cells[0].startswith("Class code"):
            in_table = True
        elif is_table and in_table and not all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", cell) for cell in cells):
            if len(cells) != 3 or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]-\d+", cells[0]) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d+", cells[1]) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?", cells[2]) or cells[0] in seen:
                issues.append(OpenItem("Application", "Malformed or duplicated application class row.", "Confirm the original reported code, employee count and payroll table.", (_source(document, "application"),)))
                return None
            reported.append(ApplicationClass(cells[0], int(cells[1]), Decimal(cells[2]), _reference(document, offset, offset + len(line), f"application class {cells[0]}")))
            seen.add(cells[0])
        offset += len(line)
    if not reported:
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application", "No valid reported class/payroll rows were found.", "Provide the employer's payroll split.", (_source(document, "application"),)))
        return None
    application_cents = {row.class_code: _cents(row.payroll, "Application") for row in reported}
    report_total = sum(application_cents.values())
    register_total = sum(_cents(row.wages, "Register") for row in register)
    difference = register_total - report_total
    pending = _cents(allocation.reconciliation.unresolved_total, "Unresolved register payroll")
    deltas = {code: _money(_cents(by_code.get(code, Decimal("0")), "Verified payroll") - application_cents.get(code, 0)) for code in sorted(set(by_code) | set(application_cents))}
    definitive = not any(line.status == "OPEN" for line in allocation.lines) and not adjustment_open
    if difference or sum(row.employees for row in reported) != len(register):
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application/register comparison", "The application payroll total or employee count conflicts with the payroll register.", "Confirm and correct the application; retain register wages without altering them to force agreement.", tuple(row.source for row in reported)))
    if not definitive or any(value != 0 for value in deltas.values()):
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application/classification comparison", "The verified allocation differs from the application or contains OPEN payroll; class differences are provisional while payroll remains unresolved.", "Confirm the evidence-backed classification changes and resolve pending employee decisions; the application is not classification authority.", tuple(row.source for row in reported)))
    return ApplicationComparison(tuple(reported), _money(report_total), _money(register_total), _money(difference), deltas, _money(pending), definitive)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Inputs:
    guide: MarkdownSource
    records_root: Path
    records: tuple[MarkdownSource | CSVSource, ...]


def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        # Preserve line endings and any BOM in source text for later citation.
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
            return source.read()
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: expected UTF-8 text: {exc}") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: cannot read source: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc


def read_markdown(path: str | Path) -> MarkdownSource:
    """Preserve Markdown text and paragraph-definition identifiers in source order."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    identifiers = tuple(_PARAGRAPH.findall(text.removeprefix("\ufeff")))
    return MarkdownSource(path, text, identifiers)


def _csv_lines(text: str, path: Path) -> Iterable[str]:
    """Check quote placement that csv.reader(strict=True) otherwise accepts."""
    state = "start"
    for line_number, line in enumerate(io.StringIO(text.removeprefix("\ufeff"), newline=""), 1):
        for character in line:
            if state == "quoted":
                if character == '"':
                    state = "closed"
            elif state == "closed":
                if character == '"':  # Doubled quote within a quoted field.
                    state = "quoted"
                elif character in ",\r\n":
                    state = "start"
                else:
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: character after closing quote")
            elif character == '"':
                if state != "start":
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: quote inside unquoted field")
                state = "quoted"
            elif character in ",\r\n":
                state = "start"
            else:
                state = "bare"
        yield line


def read_csv(
    path: str | Path, *, money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> CSVSource:
    """Read a strict CSV table, converting configured money columns to Decimal."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    money_columns = frozenset(money_columns)
    parser = csv.reader(_csv_lines(text, path), strict=True)
    rows = []
    try:
        header = next(parser, None)
        if not header:
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV header is missing")
        if any(not name or name != name.strip() for name in header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV headers must be nonblank without surrounding whitespace")
        if len(set(header)) != len(header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: duplicate CSV header")
        while True:
            line_number = parser.line_num + 1
            row = next(parser, None)
            if row is None:
                break
            if not row:  # Blank physical lines do not create evidence rows.
                continue
            if len(row) != len(header):
                raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: expected {len(header)} fields, got {len(row)}")
            values: dict[str, str | Decimal] = dict(zip(header, row))
            for column, value in zip(header, row):
                if column in money_columns:
                    if not _MONEY.fullmatch(value.strip()):
                        raise InputError(
                            f"{path}:{line_number}: invalid money in column {column!r}: {value!r}; "
                            "expected plain decimal dollars with at most two fractional digits"
                        )
                    values[column] = Decimal(value.strip())
            rows.append(CSVRow(line_number, values))
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}:{parser.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}") from exc
    return CSVSource(path, text, tuple(header), tuple(rows))


def read_inputs(
    guide_path: str | Path,
    employer_records_path: str | Path,
    *,
    money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> Inputs:
    """Reread a guide and all Markdown/CSV records below a caller-supplied directory.

    The directory can hold one employer or any number of employer subdirectories.
    No employer names, minimum employer count, or classification answers are assumed.
    """
    guide = read_markdown(guide_path)
    if not guide.paragraph_ids:
        raise InputError(f"{guide.path}: no classification paragraph identifiers (CG-...) found")
    root = Path(employer_records_path)
    try:
        is_directory = root.is_dir()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: cannot access employer records directory: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc
    if not is_directory:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: employer records directory is missing or is not a directory")

    def walk_error(exc: OSError) -> None:
        raise InputError(f"{exc.filename}: cannot list employer records: {exc.strerror}") from exc

    paths = sorted(
        Path(directory) / name
        for directory, _, names in os.walk(root, onerror=walk_error)
        for name in names
        if Path(name).suffix.lower() in {".md", ".csv"}
    )
    if not paths:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: no Markdown or CSV employer records found")
    money_columns = frozenset(money_columns)
    records = tuple(
        read_csv(path, money_columns=money_columns)
        if path.suffix.lower() == ".csv" else read_markdown(path)
        for path in paths
    )
    return Inputs(guide, root, records)


def inventory(inputs: Inputs) -> dict:
    """Summarize the input inventory without calculating payroll totals or allocations."""
    tables = [doc for doc in inputs.records if isinstance(doc, CSVSource)]
    return {
        "guide": {"path": str(inputs.guide.path), "paragraph_ids": inputs.guide.paragraph_ids},
        "records_root": str(inputs.records_root),
        "record_files": len(inputs.records),
        "markdown_files": len(inputs.records) - len(tables),
        "csv_files": len(tables),
        "csv_rows": sum(len(table.rows) for table in tables),
        "decimal_values": sum(
            isinstance(value, Decimal)
            for table in tables for row in table.rows for value in row.values.values()
        ),
        "records_by_directory": dict(sorted(Counter(
            doc.path.parent.relative_to(inputs.records_root).as_posix()
            for doc in inputs.records
        ).items())),

def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        # Preserve line endings and any BOM in source text for later citation.
        with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
            return source.read()
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: expected UTF-8 text: {exc}") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}: cannot read source: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc


def read_markdown(path: str | Path) -> MarkdownSource:
    """Preserve Markdown text and paragraph-definition identifiers in source order."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    identifiers = tuple(_PARAGRAPH.findall(text.removeprefix("\ufeff")))
    return MarkdownSource(path, text, identifiers)


def _csv_lines(text: str, path: Path) -> Iterable[str]:
    """Check quote placement that csv.reader(strict=True) otherwise accepts."""
    state = "start"
    for line_number, line in enumerate(io.StringIO(text.removeprefix("\ufeff"), newline=""), 1):
        for character in line:
            if state == "quoted":
                if character == '"':
                    state = "closed"
            elif state == "closed":
                if character == '"':  # Doubled quote within a quoted field.
                    state = "quoted"
                elif character in ",\r\n":
                    state = "start"
                else:
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: character after closing quote")
            elif character == '"':
                if state != "start":
                    raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: malformed CSV: quote inside unquoted field")
                state = "quoted"
            elif character in ",\r\n":
                state = "start"
            else:
                state = "bare"
        yield line


def read_csv(
    path: str | Path, *, money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> CSVSource:
    """Read a strict CSV table, converting configured money columns to Decimal."""
    path = Path(path)
    text = _read_text(path)
    money_columns = frozenset(money_columns)
    parser = csv.reader(_csv_lines(text, path), strict=True)
    rows = []
    try:
        header = next(parser, None)
        if not header:
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV header is missing")
        if any(not name or name != name.strip() for name in header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: CSV headers must be nonblank without surrounding whitespace")
        if len(set(header)) != len(header):
            raise InputError(f"{path}:1: duplicate CSV header")
        while True:
            line_number = parser.line_num + 1
            row = next(parser, None)
            if row is None:
                break
            if not row:  # Blank physical lines do not create evidence rows.
                continue
            if len(row) != len(header):
                raise InputError(f"{path}:{line_number}: expected {len(header)} fields, got {len(row)}")
            values: dict[str, str | Decimal] = dict(zip(header, row))
            for column, value in zip(header, row):

                            "expected plain decimal dollars with at most two fractional digits"
                        )
                    values[column] = Decimal(value.strip())
            rows.append(CSVRow(line_number, values))
    except csv.Error as exc:
        raise InputError(f"{path}:{parser.line_num}: malformed CSV: {exc}") from exc
    return CSVSource(path, text, tuple(header), tuple(rows))


def read_inputs(
    guide_path: str | Path,
    employer_records_path: str | Path,
    *,
    money_columns: Iterable[str] = DEFAULT_MONEY_COLUMNS,
) -> Inputs:
    """Reread a guide and all Markdown/CSV records below a caller-supplied directory.

    The directory can hold one employer or any number of employer subdirectories.
    No employer names, minimum employer count, or classification answers are assumed.
    """
    guide = read_markdown(guide_path)
    if not guide.paragraph_ids:
        raise InputError(f"{guide.path}: no classification paragraph identifiers (CG-...) found")
    root = Path(employer_records_path)
    try:

        raise InputError(f"{root}: cannot access employer records directory: {exc.strerror or exc}") from exc
    if not is_directory:
        raise InputError(f"{root}: employer records directory is missing or is not a directory")

    def walk_error(exc: OSError) -> None:
        raise InputError(f"{exc.filename}: cannot list employer records: {exc.strerror}") from exc

    paths = sorted(
        Path(directory) / name
        for directory, _, names in os.walk(root, onerror=walk_error)

    if document is None:
        return None
    reported = []
    offset = 0
    seen = set()
    in_table = False
    for line in document.text.splitlines(keepends=True):
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        is_table = line.lstrip().startswith("|")
        if is_table and cells[0].startswith("Class code"):
            in_table = True
        elif is_table and in_table and not all(re.fullmatch(r":?-{3,}:?", cell) for cell in cells):
            if len(cells) != 3 or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z]-\d+", cells[0]) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d+", cells[1]) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?", cells[2]) or cells[0] in seen:
                issues.append(OpenItem("Application", "Malformed or duplicated application class row.", "Confirm the original reported code, employee count and payroll table.", (_source(document, "application"),)))
                return None
            reported.append(ApplicationClass(cells[0], int(cells[1]), Decimal(cells[2]), _reference(document, offset, offset + len(line), f"application class {cells[0]}")))
            seen.add(cells[0])
        offset += len(line)
    if not reported:
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application", "No valid reported class/payroll rows were found.", "Provide the employer's payroll split.", (_source(document, "application"),)))
        return None
    application_cents = {row.class_code: _cents(row.payroll, "Application") for row in reported}
    report_total = sum(application_cents.values())
    register_total = sum(_cents(row.wages, "Register") for row in register)
    difference = register_total - report_total
    pending = _cents(allocation.reconciliation.unresolved_total, "Unresolved register payroll")
    deltas = {code: _money(_cents(by_code.get(code, Decimal("0")), "Verified payroll") - application_cents.get(code, 0)) for code in sorted(set(by_code) | set(application_cents))}
    definitive = not any(line.status == "OPEN" for line in allocation.lines) and not adjustment_open
    if difference or sum(row.employees for row in reported) != len(register):
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application/register comparison", "The application payroll total or employee count conflicts with the payroll register.", "Confirm and correct the application; retain register wages without altering them to force agreement.", tuple(row.source for row in reported)))
    if not definitive or any(value != 0 for value in deltas.values()):
        issues.append(OpenItem("Application/classification comparison", "The verified allocation differs from the application or contains OPEN payroll; class differences are provisional while payroll remains unresolved.", "Confirm the evidence-backed classification changes and resolve pending employee decisions; the application is not classification authority.", tuple(row.source for row in reported)))
    return ApplicationComparison(tuple(reported), _money(report_total), _money(register_total), _money(difference), deltas, _money(pending), definitive)

import csv

from pathlib import Path

import tempfile
import unittest

from test_rule_evaluator import INTERVIEW

GUIDE = OFFICE_GUIDE + """
**CG-31. T-610 Courier and delivery drivers.** Drivers of vans and light trucks delivering parcels and documents,
and helpers who ride on the delivery vehicles.
"""
BUSINESS = """# Independent delivery business
Audit period January 5, 2026 to January 18, 2026.
Independent Delivery runs same-day document and parcel delivery for local businesses, two van routes two days a week.
Four employees, paid weekly.
"""
NOTES = """# Auditor field notes
Dispatch office with two desks and a radio; two vans. The dispatcher, Inside Person, was on the radio.
The route log lists every route day with its driver and anyone riding along. Pay weeks run Monday to Sunday.
"""
REGISTER = """employee_id,name,position,wages_paid
D1,Driver One,Driver,200.02
D2,Driver Two,Driver,180.04
I1,Inside Person,Dispatcher,60.02
B1,Books Person,Bookkeeper,40.10
"""
APPLICATION = """# Application
| Class code (employer's choice) | Employees | Payroll (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| T-610 | 2 | 380.06 |
| C-110 | 2 | 100.12 |
"""
ROUTE_HEADER = "date,route_id,driver_id,ride_along_id,stops\n"
WEEK_HEADER = "week_start,week_end,employee_id,gross_pay\n"


class CourierIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.employer = self.root / "independent-delivery-inputs"
        self.employer.mkdir()
        self.guide = self.root / "guide.md"
        self.guide.write_text(GUIDE, encoding="utf-8")
        self.interview = self.root / "interview.md"
        self.interview.write_text(INTERVIEW, encoding="utf-8")
        for filename, text in {"business-description.md": BUSINESS, "field-notes.md": NOTES,
            "payroll-register.csv": REGISTER, "application.md": APPLICATION}.items():
            (self.employer / filename).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        rows = []
        for start in (date(2026, 1, 5), date(2026, 1, 12)):
            for employee, pay in (("D1", "100.01"), ("D2", "90.02"), ("I1", "30.01"), ("B1", "20.05")):
                rows.append(f"{start},{start + timedelta(days=6)},{employee},{pay}\n")
        self.weekly = WEEK_HEADER + "".join(rows)
        (self.employer / "weekly-payroll.csv").write_text(self.weekly, encoding="utf-8")
        self.routes()

    def routes(self, counts=(1, 2)):
        rows = []
        for week, start in enumerate((date(2026, 1, 5), date(2026, 1, 12))):
            for index, offset in enumerate((0, 6)):
                for route, driver in (("X", "D1"), ("Y", "D2")):
                    rider = "I1" if route == "X" and index < counts[week] else ""
                    rows.append(f"{start + timedelta(days=offset)},{route},{driver},{rider},10\n")
        (self.employer / "route-log.csv").write_text(ROUTE_HEADER + "".join(rows), encoding="utf-8")

    def run_courier(self, **kwargs):
        return process_employer(self.guide, self.employer, self.interview, **kwargs)

    def week(self, result, employee="I1", start=date(2026, 1, 5)):
        return next(row for row in result.weekly_results if row.employee_id == employee and row.week_start == start)

    def test_whole_week_threshold_and_independent_reconciliation(self):
        result = self.run_courier()
        self.assertEqual(result.by_code, {"T-610": Decimal("410.07"), "C-110": Decimal("70.11")})
        self.assertEqual(result.employee_totals["I1"], {"T-610": Decimal("30.01"), "C-110": Decimal("30.01")})
        self.assertEqual(len(result.weekly_results), 8)
        self.assertTrue(result.weekly_reconciliation.reconciled)
        self.assertEqual(result.weekly_reconciliation.weekly_total, Decimal("480.18"))
        self.assertTrue(result.independent_reconciliation.reconciled)
        self.assertEqual(result.application.verified_differences, {"T-610": Decimal("30.01"), "C-110": Decimal("-30.01")})

    def test_zero_one_two_day_boundaries_and_bookkeeper_rides(self):
        for count, code in ((0, "C-110"), (1, "C-110"), (2, "T-610")):
            with self.subTest(days=count):
                self.routes((count, count))
                self.assertEqual(self.week(self.run_courier()).decision.class_code, code)
        path = self.employer / "route-log.csv"
        path.write_text(path.read_text().replace(",I1,", ",B1,"), encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(self.week(self.run_courier(), "B1").decision.class_code, "T-610")

    def test_distinct_dates_ignore_two_rides_on_the_same_day(self):
        self.routes((1, 1))
        path = self.employer / "route-log.csv"
        path.write_text(path.read_text().replace("2026-01-05,Y,D2,,", "2026-01-05,Y,D2,I1,"), encoding="utf-8")
        row = self.week(self.run_courier())
        self.assertEqual(row.ride_days, (date(2026, 1, 5),))
        self.assertEqual(row.decision.class_code, "C-110")

    def test_sunday_and_following_monday_belong_to_separate_pay_weeks(self):
        self.routes((0, 1))
        path = self.employer / "route-log.csv"
        path.write_text(path.read_text().replace("2026-01-11,X,D1,,", "2026-01-11,X,D1,I1,"), encoding="utf-8")
        result = self.run_courier()
        self.assertEqual(self.week(result).decision.class_code, "C-110")
        self.assertEqual(self.week(result, start=date(2026, 1, 12)).decision.class_code, "C-110")

    def test_weekly_parts_preserve_dates_ids_raw_money_and_rule_sources(self):
        result = self.run_courier()
        row = self.week(result)
        self.assertEqual(row.week_end, date(2026, 1, 11))

        self.assertTrue(any(ref.locator == "CG-31" for ref in row.decision.rule_sources))
